title: Checks (check/1)
description: A check/1 file: the seven kinds of data quality check. The same list is the checks section of format 2 of a definition (the semantic package, DbDataStore's model, the serving data source); $defs.check is one entry of it.

dataset.description: The dataset the checks that name none are about.

check.description: One check of check/1. The loader also refuses what a schema cannot say: a range with min above max, a check id used twice, a dataset left out where no default exists, a referential check with another number of columns than its target.

oneOf.description: No value of the columns is null.

id.description: Names the check in its results and statuses; unique within a section.

dataset.description: The lineage identity of the dataset or entity the check is about (scheme://server/name), or its name inside the definition that holds the check. A check file may give a default for all its checks.

severity.description: warn tells the owner; block stops the dependents of the dataset.

on_error.description: What a check that cannot run does (its result is error): alert, or block all the same.

column.description: The one column the check is about.

columns.description: The columns the check is about.

oneOf.description: No combination of the columns' values occurs twice.
